svg.title: The recorded routing loop
svg.desc: Each OS turn passes route_and_record in shadow mode; the bundled policy decides; the outcome is joined to the decision in the routing ledger and the audit chain. A dashed feedback arrow back to the router is marked not consumed yet.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Every turn is a labelled example: what the skill would have done, what actually ran, how it ended.
